description: Language-neutral search test vectors, exported from the desktop search engine (qbible.search, FTS5) by tools/export_search_cases.py against the bundled KJV pack. Any qbible client must produce the same 'terms' (Term.describe), the same error 'code' for rejected queries, and for searches the same 'total', 'has_more', ordered result keys (canonical order, or BM25 relevance with ties broken by verse order) and highlight segments.
